_comment_install_behaviour:
=== INSTALL BEHAVIOUR ===
Controls what happens when the user clicks Install for a component.
installWarnings shows a blocking confirm dialog before proceeding (keys: reshade, renodx, relimiter, dc, optiscaler, luma, reframework, dxvk).
forceExternalOnly redirects the install button to an external URL instead of downloading.
snapshotOverrides injects or overrides the addon download URL when wiki scraping fails.
dllNameOverrides forces specific proxy DLL filenames (e.g. winmm.dll instead of dxgi.dll).
gacSymlinkGames routes XNA Framework games through a GAC symlink install (requires admin).
launchExeOverrides sets the relative exe path used when clicking Launch and for NVIDIA profile matching.
renodxIniOverrides injects keys into [renodx] reshade.ini section on install/update.
legacyReShadeVersions auto-assigns a locked ReShade version channel to specific games.

ℹ️ This game has both 32-bit and 64-bit RenoDX builds.

Dragon Quest VII Reimagined.notes:
ℹ️ Optional: Enable HDR from Engine.ini with DQ7RFix. see below.
Add the following cvars to the DQ7RFix.ini.

r.AllowHDR=1
r.HDR.EnableHDROutput=1
r.HDR.Display.OutputDevice=5
r.HDR.Display.ColorGamut=2
r.HDR.UI.CompositeMode=1
r.HDR.UI.Level=1.5

The game has to be run in DX11 mode with '-dx11' argument.

If using the recommended Engine.ini route then you must also set the Processing Path to Engine HDR in the RenoDX tab of ReShade once in game.

This is reported to have the best result. SDR upgrade with DX11 and DX12 still works, but can exhibit UI/fog rendering problems.

_comment_packs_components:
=== PACKS & COMPONENT URLS ===
shaderPacks adds, modifies, or disables shader packs without a client update.
addonPacks adds, modifies, or disables addon pack entries without a client update.
componentUrls overrides download URLs for specific components (keys: ueExtended, ueDofFix, dc).
renodxExtraSettings adds extra toggle rows to the RenoDX cog Compatibility Settings dialog.

reeShaders.description: Lightweight sharpening (TinySharpen), clarity, and chromatic aberration shaders

CubeLUT3Ddith.description: Cube 3D LUT shader with dithering to reduce banding. Requires a .cube LUT file placed in the Textures folder.

DLSS5Feeder.description: Companion shader for the DLSS5 Feeder addon. Requires the DLSS5 Feeder addon and iMMERSE LaunchPad.

ReshadeMotionEstimation.description: Dense real-time optical flow motion estimation via block matching and pyramids.

renodx-devkit.description: RenoDX development and debugging tools for shader authors

renodx-dlssfix.description: Makes ReShade draw on native game frames instead of generated frames. Also hides DLSS upscaling from ReShade.

dlss5-dx11-bridge.description: Enables DLSS 5 Neural Rendering in DX11 and Vulkan games that already have native DLSS. Mirrors the game’s DLSS onto a private DX12 session for the NR addon to hook.

dlss5-feed.description: Enables DLSS 5 Neural Rendering in games with no native DLSS (DX11, DX12, Vulkan, OpenGL, 32-bit). Feeds a synthetic DLSS contract from ReShade depth and motion vectors. Requires motion vector shaders — see How To Use.

mfgunlock.description: Unlocks DLSS Multi Frame Generation (3x/4x and above) on RTX 40-series cards, which NVIDIA ships gated to RTX 50-series only. Corrects frame interpolation so generated frames carry new motion. In-memory only — no files on disk are modified. Requires a game with DLSS frame generation via Streamline and a modern nvngx_dlssg.dll (310.x).

renodx-upgrade.description: Enables inverse tone mapping (ITM) and resource upgrades for HDR in DX9+ games. Use with RenoFX HDR Toolkit shader for full HDR conversion. Not needed alongside RenoDX or Luma mods.
